runs.label: Over-corrects
runs.text: Replans every 5 actions — far more often than the chunk was trained to be executed. The pusher jitters against the block and never commits to a full push.

runs.label: Recovering
runs.text: Enough open-loop commitment to move the block, enough feedback to correct. On this episode it lands at 0.99 — a near-miss under the 0.95 coverage threshold.

runs.label: Peak
runs.text: The best setting I measured, and it beats my diffusion baseline's 30% on identical data and training budget. Same weights as the 0% run — only the replanning interval changed.

runs.label: Drifting
runs.text: Starting to overshoot. The block gets close to the goal pose and the policy is already committed to actions that carry it past.

runs.label: Library default
runs.text: Commits to all 100 predicted actions before looking again. It ploughs past the goal pose and has no chance to correct. Every one of the 50 episodes fails.
